partnershipPlan: A surgical nurse manager and a patient partner review the committee summary; a surgeon and an intensivist on the committee comment on the strand B coding themes before coding starts.
socialListening: No social media listening; professional society newsletters are searched as grey literature, not treated as voices.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: A note that turns up at two in the afternoon, after we have left for theatre, is a note nobody reads.
items.implication: Chart timing in every strand B study.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Our own pharmacist on the round, yes; an email from someone we have never met, no.
items.implication: Chart whether the pharmacist was part of the team.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I am the one who says, the pharmacist wants this stopped today, and I am never in the report.
items.implication: Include nurse-focused reports in strand B.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Nobody drives two hours for a handshake round; tell us what works by phone.
items.implication: Chart telephone delivery and small-hospital reports explicitly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: They switched my drip to tablets and nobody told me why.
items.implication: Note whether any study reported patient communication.

summary: Five composite voices on timing, trust, nurses, small hospitals and patients.
